texts: An artificial neural network-based model is more akin to an algorithm, though it encompasses aspects that go beyond traditional algorithms. It can be seen as a sophisticated type of algorithm designed to learn from data, adjusting its parameters through training. Unlike a standard program that follows a set of predefined instructions, a neural network model adapts and improves over time with exposure to new data, making it more flexible and powerful in complex problem-solving scenarios. This learning process involves 2 main phases: training and testing.

An artificial neural network (ANN)-based model shares characteristics with both computer programs and algorithms, but it is more accurately described as an algorithm. This is because, like an algorithm, an ANN follows a set of rules and procedures to process information and solve problems, yet it learns and adapts through training on data, involving 2 or more layers of computational units.

An artificial neural network (ANN)-based model shares characteristics with both computer programs and algorithms, but it is more akin to an algorithm due to its procedural nature and ability to learn from data. However, unlike a traditional algorithm that follows a set of predefined instructions, an ANN evolves its behavior through training, making it adaptable and less rigid. This evolution aspect sets it apart, incorporating 2 key elements: learning and adaptation.

An artificial neural network (ANN) based model can be considered as a type of algorithm that operates within a computer program. ANNs consist of layers of nodes, often numbering in the hundreds (100's) or thousands (1000's), which process information through weighted connections. Thus, while it functions as part of a program, its core nature is that of a sophisticated algorithm designed to learn from data.
